Rooted in Excellence, Growing for the Future

Pioneering advanced commercial poultry, aquaculture, and modern farm management across Nigeria.

Our Journey

A Legacy of Agricultural Innovation

01

Setting the Standard

We recognized the incredible outlook for Nigerian farming and food production growth early on. Agrited responded to this prospect by offering investors the opportunity to establish and meticulously set up advanced commercial poultry and aquaculture farms.

02

Turn-Key Management

Our team of experts professionally run, train, and commission local staff in modern farm management. From Broilers and Layers to Processing Plants and Feed Mills, we provide efficient, highly profitable operations and continue to oversee and support them after handover.
